title: Awesome Alhambra tour!
text: Amazing tour of the Alhambra. We covered all the key sights, and our guide was wonderful! Extremely knowledgeable, friendly, and couldn’t have been nicer.
author: M5105OAwilliamr

title: Alhambra Tour
text: Our guide, Georgia, was fantastic! Her knowledge and passion for the Alhambra really came through as she guided us thru such a magical place. Highly recommend!
author: brandon_M

title: We were dazzled by everything we saw on this visit
text: Excellent experience on the private tour of the Alhambra, Nasrid Palaces, Generalife, Alcazaba, Palace of Charles V.  The guide Arnau Dkaidek Torres was excellent. Your solid knowledge, your very didactic presentation, and your human warmth enriched us greatly. Thank you very much.
author: Wander37716133462

title: Wonderful
text: It was an excellent tour, Antonio explained everything perfectly and is very knowledgeable, it was three hours of tour that went by very quickly because of how interesting and pleasant Antonio's explanations were. Highly recommended.
author: Navigator02998249767

title: Excellent Guide
text: Our guide had in depth knowledge of the history of Spain, Alhambra, Islam and Christianity. We saw it all and he made our tour of an amazing place a wonderful experience.
author: Ullrich_A

title: Awesome tour!
text: One of the best tours we have ever done!! Instructions to meeting place was perfect.   Our guide Georgia was outstanding!! The complex is vast and I can't imagine trying to find my way around.  She knew the best way to go and so many facts.  When our group got a little hot she quickly adjusted.   We loved it, so glad for a private tour.
author: Jennifer_D

title: Alhambra Paradise
text: Outstanding!  Maria Theresa, our guide, was friendly, knowledgable and patient with all the many questions we had.  She provided good knowledge of the history and architecture of the Alhambra.  She came ready with our tickets - very organised - and able to skip the lines.  Although it was very crowded with tourists she easily navigated us through the crowds and allowed us to take as many pictures as we liked.  We did have some difficulty with the meeting point, but shared this with Maria Theresa, who already thought of a good solution to make it more clear for future clients.
author: Michelle_F

title: Our guide Anna was...
text:
Our guide Anna was thorough and friendly. Knowledgeable and made the tour interesting.
The meeting point however was a bit confusing as Google Maps led us to another place. Access to attractions was no fuss.
author: fabian

title: We had an amazing tour...
text: We had an amazing tour guide, Anis. He was a wealth of knowledge and was happy to answer any of our questions. It was a private tour that encompassed the entire compound and he shared details about everything including the plants and trees and the gardens. He is very passionate about the history of his home town and the Alhambra. We couldn’t have had a better experience.
author: Virginia_R

title: This was an extremely...
text: This was an extremely well thought out tour. Our guide, Guillermo, had enclopedia-level knowledge of the Alhambra and he made it so interesting that we loved every minute. Absolutely fascinating experience we would highly recommend!
author: Karen_A
